_meta.description: Hand-curated cr: keys for the 64 research bodies kept in phase 1 (76 minus the 2 exclusions, the 9 bodies held out in seed/founding_years.json, and state-of-regulars, held out by controller ruling because one research record conflates two bodies). Keys follow design §4 and the Global Constraints: Latin, the distinguishing noun phrase in the nominative, kind words and the governing preposition dropped, et kept, ASCII-folded, founding year appended. minted_from_la is the research names[].name_la string (or the substring of it) the slug was derived from: the current name for a living body, the last name for an ended one. rule_note records every judgment and is the Latinist's review list.
conventions: Kind words stripped as listed in design §4 rule 3. By analogy, also stripped: 'Pontificia Commissio' (as 'Pontificia Academia'), 'Consilium' and 'Sacrum Consilium' (the Latin term of kinds.json 'council'), 'Secretaria' (as 'Secretariatus'), 'Supremum' (as 'Suprema'), and the adjective 'specialis' qualifying the kind word. Each case is flagged in its rule_note.

Governing prepositions dropped: 'pro' and 'de' (design), and by analogy 'ad' and 'super'. A preposition inside the remaining phrase (governing a complement of the noun, not of the kind word) is kept: flagged in rule_note.
Gerundives are kept and put in the nominative with the rest of the phrase ('Normalize the rest to the nominative', design §4 rule 3); source word order is kept.

founded_date is present only where research erected.date is the signing date and the research's own names[0].from (the effective date, matching the research event date) differs; design §4 rule 4 and Global Constraints: the year the founding act took effect governs.

entries.rule_note: Regular: 'Dicasterium' and 'pro' dropped; 'Doctrina Fidei' already nominative. Design example. Research name note: the Latin of PE was not checked (English text read). Year 1542 from Licet ab initio as recited in Integrae servandae; the Catholic Encyclopedia dates the congregation (as opposed to the tribunal) to 1558 (research erected.note) — a year question for review before freezing.
Kind words 'Sacra Congregatio' dropped; nominative reconstructed from the genitive 'Indicis' -> 'Index'. Founding year 1571 is secondary (Catholic Encyclopedia; act not identified).

'Pontificia Commissio' dropped as a kind phrase by analogy with 'Pontificia Academia' (the list names only 'Commissio'); guillemets dropped; 'Ecclesia Dei' is already nominative (the incipit of Ecclesia Dei adflicta).

'Pontificia Commissio' and 'pro' dropped; nominative 'Tutela Minorum' (ablative Tutela -> nominative, same spelling). The Latin name is secondary (research name verified: false); the 2014 chirograph was not read.

Ended 2022: minted from the last name (PB heading as rendered by vatican.va). 'Congregatio' and 'pro' dropped; nominative reconstructed 'Evangelizatione' -> 'Evangelizatio'; source word order kept ('Gentium Evangelizatio'). The common name 'Propaganda Fide' (1622-1968, and the 1968 suffix 'seu de Propaganda Fide') is not used: rule 2 mints from the last name. Whether 'seu de Propaganda Fide' survived in the official name is open (research: Annuario needed).

Name as in Dei providentis (research, primary). Sapienti consilio 6° n.6 has the plural 'Congregationem pro Negotiis rituum orientalium' (-> 'negotia-rituum-orientalium'); the singular of the later act was chosen. Founding year 1862 is secondary.

'Dicasterium' and 'pro' dropped; nominative plural reconstructed 'Ecclesiis Orientalibus' -> 'Ecclesiae Orientales'. Research: the Latin title in PE was not checked ('presumably' unchanged; English 'Eastern' translates 'Orientalibus', H18).

Ended 1969: last name. Research name_la holds two variants ('Sacra Congregatio Rituum / Congregatio sacrorum Rituum'); chose 'Sacra Congregatio Rituum', the form of REU n.58, the last governing act to name it. 'Sacra Congregatio' dropped; nominative plural reconstructed 'Rituum' -> 'Ritus' (4th declension). With the other variant the slug would be 'sacri-ritus'.
Regular: 'Sacra Congregatio' and 'pro' dropped; nominative 'Cultus Divinus'. Design example (H6): same slug as cr:cultus-divinus-1984, distinguished by the founding year.

The inner 'de' is kept: it belongs to the title of the conciliar constitution, not to the body's name; 'Sacra' here is part of 'Sacra Liturgia', not the kind word. Flag: without the kind word the slug reads like a document; the Latinist may prefer keeping 'consilium'. Latin name and founding year 1964 are secondary (research: Sacram Liturgiam, secondary).
'Dicasterium' and 'de' dropped; nominative plural reconstructed 'Causis' -> 'Causae'. Research: PE Latin form not checked.
Ended 1975: last (only) name. 'Sacra Congregatio' and 'de' dropped; 'disciplina Sacramentorum' nominative (ablative disciplina -> nominative, same spelling).

entries.minted_from_la: Dicasterium pro Institutis Vitae Consecratae et Societatibus Vitae Apostolicae

entries.minted_from_la: Congregatio de Seminariis atque Studiorum Institutis

'Congregatio' and 'de' dropped; nominative plural reconstructed 'Seminariis ... Institutis' -> 'Seminaria ... Instituta'; connective 'atque' kept like 'et'. With the other variant (the REU name, common usage 'Catholic Education') the slug would be 'institutio-catholica'. Research: official form needs the Annuario. entries.minted_from_la: Pontificium Consilium pro Dialogo cum Non Credentibus

entries.minted_from_la: Pontificium Consilium de Spirituali Migrantium atque Itinerantium Cura

entries.minted_from_la: Dicasterium pro Integra Humana Progressione Fovenda

entries.minted_from_la: Pontificia Commissio ad Codicis canones authentice interpretandos

entries.minted_from_la: Sacrum Consilium pro Publicis Ecclesiae negotiis

Negotia'; source word order kept. The research models one body from 1793; kept, pending review. Founding year 1793 secondary.

No kind word to strip ('Administratio' is the distinctive head noun, kind 'office'); already nominative. YEAR FLAG: research erected.date 1967-08-15 is REU's signing date; REU took effect 1968-01-01 (research names[0].from, kind and event ev052), and the effective year governs (design §4 rule 4; research method §1: 'from' = date the act took effect). Flag for the Latinist: alternatives 'secretaria-pro-re-oeconomica' (literal) or 'secretaria-rei-oeconomicae' (genitive, like 'secretaria-status').

Kind word KEPT, for the same collision reason as cr:secretaria-res-oeconomica-2014 (same act, same year). 'pro' dropped; nominative reconstructed. Flag: alternatives 'consilium-pro-re-oeconomica' or 'consilium-rei-oeconomicae'.
